item.title: Rohit Shetty firing case: Main shooter arrested, Bishnoi gang link under probe
item.description: Rohit Shetty firing case takes a dramatic turn as police arrest the alleged shooter linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. The accused will be produced in court today. Here’s a detailed breakdown of the weapons trail and investigation so far.

item.title: Creative Ramadan craft ideas for kids to learn culture through fun activities
item.description: Ramadan crafts help children express creativity while learning about culture and tradition. Here are the simple Ramadan crafts for kids to help families celebrate the holy month in meaningful ways.

item.title: Telangana Municipal elections: Mayors and chairpersons to be elected today
item.description: With no clear majority in 37 municipalities and municipal corporations, the post-poll phase has given way to aggressive camp politics.

item.title: What after 12th boards? Creative careers as a serious option
item.description: Fields such as media, communication, design, fashion, music, animation and gaming are growing rapidly. The creative industries value trained, skilled and creative professionals who combine imagination with business and technological knowledge.

item.title: Kwality Wall’s shares debut weak post-HUL demerger on Dalal Street: Key Details
item.description: Kwality Wall’s India Ltd shares experienced a weak debut on Dalal Street, listing at a significant discount following its demerger from Hindustan Unilever. The stock traded lower on both NSE and BSE, entering the ‘T Group’ segment for its initial 10 sessions. This trading action follows HUL’s demerger approval and NCLT nod, marking a new chapter for the ice cream business.

item.title: Noida: 3-year-old dies after falling in pit in Dalelgarh village, fourth incident in weeks
item.description: A feast was going on at the village at the time, and people had gathered near the temple for the same. It was near this temple that the pit was located and people saw the child, slipping and falling inside. Immediately locals raised an alarm and rushed to help. The villagers did manage to pull Devansh out of the pit, but by that time he had already died.

item.title: World’s largest neutrino detector has been upgraded
item.description: Scientists have successfully upgraded the IceCube neutrino observatory at the south pole. The instrument detects elusive neutrino particles, trillions of which pass through all of us every second.

item.title: Land for 1 Cent: How Andhra Pradesh plans to beat China in AI race
item.description: Andhra Pradesh has announced a massive $175 billion plan to transform Visakhapatnam into a global artificial intelligence hub. Tech giants like Google and Reliance are set to build huge data centres in the city, which Minister Nara Lokesh claims will become a central ecosystem for India’s digital future.

item.title: Global EV registrations fall 3 percent in January 2026
item.description: Global electric vehicle registrations dropped 3 per cent year on year in January 2026 to nearly 1.2 million units. Weak demand in China and North America, along with policy changes and subsidy cuts, weighed on sales, while Europe and emerging markets posted growth.

item.title: Sam Altman in Delhi: Confirms massive ChatGPT growth before AI Summit
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has revealed that India now has 100 million weekly active ChatGPT users. Speaking ahead of the India AI Impact Summit 2026 in New Delhi, he highlighted that students are driving this growth while warning about the need for better infrastructure to ensure equal access.
